findings.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
findings.description: Net PH_VCM has 22% reference plane coverage over 28.3mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has major reference plane gap

findings.title: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.description: Net PH_IN has 75% reference plane coverage over 4.1mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has significant reference plane gap

findings.title: Signal has partial reference plane gap
findings.description: Net I2C_SDA has 94% reference plane coverage over 26.0mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.

findings.summary: Signal has partial reference plane gap

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (HOST / JST PH6) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (INSULATED BNC) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has proper ground connection to chassis/enclosure. Add ESD protection if connected to external antenna.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (50×35mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1429 MHz; (0,1) at 2042 MHz; (1,1) at 2492 MHz; (2,0) at 2858 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.title: Incomplete ground pour at board edges
findings.description: Ground pour covers ~63% of the board perimeter (14/38 sample points lack nearby ground zone). A continuous ground guard ring around the board perimeter reduces edge radiation. (Note: uses bounding box approximation.)
findings.recommendation: Add ground pour on outer layers extending to within 2mm of all board edges, connected by stitching vias.
findings.summary: Incomplete ground pour at board edges

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: REF_2V048
findings.description: Net REF_2V048 has 5 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 5 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: REF_2V048

findings.title: differential diff pair skew approaching limit
findings.description: Differential pair ADC_P/ADC_N has 7.2mm length mismatch (39.3 ps skew). differential limit is 50 ps.
findings.recommendation: Match trace lengths to within 25 ps (4.6mm). Use length-matched serpentine routing.
findings.summary: differential diff pair skew approaching limit

findings.title: differential diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net ADC_P (part of differential diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, F.Cu) with 2 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
